        Dijkstra(int n) {
            N = n;

            for (int i = 0; i <= N; i++) E.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }
        void insert(int u, int v, int w) {
            E.get(u).add(new Pair<>(v,w));
        }
        int[] dijkstra(int start, int end) {
            int[] dist = new int[N+1];
            Arrays.fill(dist, INF);
            dist[start] = 0;
            PriorityQueue<Pair<Integer,Integer>> pq = new PriorityQueue<>((a,b) -> a.first - b.first);
            pq.add(new Pair<>(0, start));
            while (!pq.isEmpty()) {
                Pair<Integer,Integer> cur = pq.poll();
                int w = -cur.first;
                int u = cur.second;
                if (u == end) return dist;
                if (dist[u] < w) continue;
                for (int i = 0; i < E.get(u).size(); i++) {
                    int v = E.get(u).get(i).first;
                    int w2 = w + E.get(u).get(i).second;
                    if (dist[v] > w2) {
                        dist[v] = w2;
                        pq.add(new Pair<>(-w2, v));
                    }
                }
            }
            return dist;
        }
        void g() {
            Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
            int n = sc.nextInt(), e = sc.nextInt();
            Dijkstra dk = new Dijkstra(n);

                int u = sc.nextInt(), v = sc.nextInt(), w = sc.nextInt();
                dk.insert(u,v,w);
            }
            int[] ans = dk.dijkstra(s, n);
            for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                if (ans[i] >= INF) System.out.println("INF");
                else System.out.println(ans[i]);
            }
        }
    }

                x /= 10;
            }
            int n = v.size();
            for (int i = 0; i < n / 2; i++) if (v.get(i) != v.get(n - i - 1)) return 0;

    static class BigNumber {
        String add(String s1, String s2) {
            int n1 = s1.length(), n2 = s2.length();
            ArrayList<Integer> v = new ArrayList<>();
            int i = n1 - 1, j = n2 - 1;
            while (i >= 0 && j >= 0) {
                int a = s1.charAt(i) - '0' + s2.charAt(j) - '0';
                v.add(a);
                i--; j--;
            }
            while (i >= 0) {
                v.add(s1.charAt(i) - '0');
                i--;
            }
            while (j >= 0) {
                v.add(s2.charAt(j) - '0');
                j--;
            }
            int carry = 0;
            for (int k = 0; k < v.size(); k++) {
                carry += v.get(k);
                if (carry >= 10) {
                    v.set(k, carry - 10);
                    carry = 1;
                } else {
                    v.set(k, carry);
                    carry = 0;
                }
            }
            if (carry > 0) v.add(carry);
            StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder(v.size());
            for (int k = v.size() - 1; k >= 0; k--) sb.append((char)(v.get(k) + '0'));
            sb.append('\n');
            return sb.toString();
        }
    }

    static class PrimeNumber {
        int N;
        boolean[] NP;
        ArrayList<Integer> P;
        long _powmod(long a, long b) {
            if (b == 0) return 1;
            if (b % 2 == 1) return a * _powmod(a, b-1) % MOD;
            return _powmod(a * a % MOD, b / 2);
        }
        PrimeNumber() {}
        PrimeNumber(int n) {
            N = n;
            NP = new boolean[N+1];
            P = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 2; i * i <= N; i++) {
                if (NP[i]) continue;
                for (int j = i * i; j <= N; j += i) NP[j] = true;
            }
            for (int i = 2; i <= N; i++) if (!NP[i]) P.add(i);
        }
        long gcd(long x, long y) {
            while (x > 0) {
                long z = y % x;
                y = x;
                x = z;
            }
            return y;
        }
        long powermod(long p, long q) {
            long g = gcd(p, q);
            p /= g; q /= g;
            return p * _powmod(q, MOD-2) % MOD;
        }
        ArrayList<Integer> factorization(int x) {
            ArrayList<Integer> ret = new ArrayList<>();
            if (x == 1) {
                ret.add(1);
                return ret;
            }
            ret.add(1); ret.add(x);
            for (int i = 2; i * i < x; i++) {
                if (x % i == 0) { ret.add(i); ret.add(x / i); }
            }
            if (i * i == x) ret.add(i);
            return ret;
        }
        int factorization2(int x) {
            int ret = 0;
            if (x == 1) return 1;
            ret = 2;
            for (int i = 2; i * i < x; i++) {
                if (x % i == 0) ret += 2;
            }
            if (i * i == x) ret++;
            return ret;
        }
    }

    static class Comb {
        static final int MOD_COMB = MOD;
        long[][] C;
        long[] F;
        int N;
        Comb() {}
        Comb(int n) {
            init(n);
        }
        void init(int n) {
            N = n;
            C = new long[N+1][];
            for (int i = 0; i <= N; i++) {
                C[i] = new long[i+1];
                Arrays.fill(C[i], 0);
                C[i][i] = C[i][0] = 1;
            }
            for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++)
                for (int j = 1; j < i; j++)
                    C[i][j] = (C[i-1][j-1] + C[i-1][j]) % MOD_COMB;
            F = new long[N+1];
            F[0] = F[1] = 1;
            for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) F[i] = (F[i-1] * i) % MOD_COMB;
        }
        long getC(int n, int r) { return C[n][r]; }
        long getF(int n) { return F[n]; }
        long get_comb(int n, int r) {
            if (n == r || r == 0) return 1;
            if (n <= 1000) return getC(n, r);
            long ret = 1;
            if (r > n / 2) r = n - r;
            for (int i = n; i > n - r; i--) ret *= i;
            for (int i = 2; i <= r; i++) ret /= i;
            return ret;
        }
    }
